info.title: CONVO API
info.description: The pinned contract for the implemented CONVO v1 HTTP surface.

200.description: Authenticated session; returns hardened session and CSRF cookies

post.description: Always returns 202 with the same body, whether or not the address has an account and whether or not the request was rate limited (IAM-03). The token is delivered out of band and never appears in a response.

202.description: Accepted. Says nothing about whether the account exists.

post.summary: Complete password recovery and revoke every session
post.description: Consumes the single-use challenge, replaces the password and revokes every session for the account in one transaction. Expired, already used and never issued all return the same 400.

204.description: Password replaced; all sessions revoked and the caller's cookies cleared.

get.summary: Read the current authenticated principal and session
List active sessions owned by the current user
Read an active session owned by the current user

delete.summary: Revoke an active session owned by the current user

204.description: Session revoked; current-session cookies are cleared when applicable

post.summary: Create the first company and Owner exactly once
Accept an invitation and join the company
post.description: Unauthenticated by necessity: the invitee may have no account yet, so the token is the only thing identifying the request. It is single-use, short-lived and rate limited for that reason, and it appears in the path, so access logs must redact it (see docs/security/threat-model.md). Unknown, expired, revoked, already-used and wrong-password all return the same 400: distinguishing them would make this an account-existence oracle for the invited address.

get.summary: List the current user's active company memberships

200.description: Active memberships resolved through tenant RLS

get.summary: List the invitations issued in this company
get.description: Requires `member.manage`. Tokens are never included. A caller with no membership receives 404, not 403.

post.description: Requires `member.manage`, CSRF and an Idempotency-Key. The role and scopes are checked against the inviter's own grants, so nobody can give away reach they do not have. Any live invitation for the same address is superseded, because two valid tokens for one seat would be two ways in. The response never contains the token.

201.description: Created. The token was handed to the delivery port, not returned here.

delete.description: Requires `member.manage` and CSRF. Revoking an invitation that is already accepted or revoked returns 404: there is no pending invitation to act on.

post.description: Requires `tenant.delete` — the one key that separates Owner from Admin, which is what makes "only an Owner may transfer ownership" true without naming the role. One live offer per company; a second returns 409.

delete.summary: Cancel an ownership offer you made
delete.description: Only the offering Owner may cancel.

post.description: Only the recipient may accept. The outgoing Owner becomes an Admin and the recipient becomes Owner in one transaction; the company is briefly Owner-less between the two updates, which is why the last-Owner constraint is deferred to commit. Anyone who is not the recipient receives 404, because whether an offer is outstanding is not their business.

get.summary: List the memberships in this company
get.description: Memberships with their role and scope grants. Requires `member.manage`. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

200.description: Memberships with their role and scope grants. Requires `member.manage`. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

patch.summary: Change a membership role, status or scopes
patch.description: Requires `member.manage` and CSRF. The delegation ceiling applies: an actor can never produce access wider than their own, which is enforced by comparing grants rather than by naming roles. Suspending or revoking your own membership is refused, and the database refuses any change that would leave the company with no active Owner.

get.summary: List the immutable permission catalogue for an authorized company admin

200.description: Permission catalogue after role.manage authorization by key

get.summary: List the company roles and the grants each holds
get.description: Roles with their permission keys and scope levels, for an effective-access preview. Requires `role.manage`. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

200.description: Roles with their permission keys and scope levels, for an effective-access preview. Requires `role.manage`. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

post.description: Requires `role.manage` and CSRF. A custom role may only carry **delegable** keys the actor already holds — the rule that stops a role being minted with `credential.rotate` and then assigned to oneself. Built-in roles are immutable and are not created here.

patch.summary: Replace a custom role’s name, description and grants
patch.description: Requires `role.manage` and CSRF. Editing a built-in role returns 409; the database refuses it too.

delete.summary: Delete a custom role nobody holds
delete.description: Requires `role.manage` and CSRF. A role still held by an active membership returns 409 rather than orphaning those memberships or silently moving people.

get.summary: List the teams in this company
get.description: Teams and their membership counts. Requires `member.manage`, because team composition decides who sees which work. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

200.description: Teams and their membership counts. Requires `member.manage`, because team composition decides who sees which work. A caller with no membership in this company receives 404, not 403: answering 403 would confirm the company exists.

post.description: Requires `member.manage` and CSRF. A team name is reserved only while the team is live, so an archived name can be reused.

patch.description: Requires `member.manage` and CSRF. Archiving keeps the team's routing history and its membership rows; deleting would take both.

post.summary: Add a membership to a team
post.description: Requires `member.manage` and CSRF. An archived team, or a membership from another company, returns 404.

delete.summary: Remove a membership from a team

BootstrapToken.name: X-Bootstrap-Token
BootstrapToken.description: Installer-provisioned secret accepted only by the one-time bootstrap operation.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Must equal the convo_csrf cookie value for state-changing authenticated requests.

RequestId.description: The accepted or server-generated request identifier.

SessionCookies.description: convo_session is HttpOnly; convo_csrf is readable by the same-origin client. Both are Secure in HTTPS deployments and SameSite=Strict.

Error.description: A safe typed failure. HTTP status carries failure semantics.

error.message: The installation bootstrap request is not valid.

details.message: A valid owner email is required.

RateLimited.description: The shared database login limit was exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current window expires.

RoleGrant.description: A permission this role holds, and how far it reaches. A denial is the ABSENCE of a grant, never a grant with scope 'none'.

Role.description: A tenant role. Authorization is decided by permission key; `name` is a label for humans and is never used in a decision.

id.description: null only for a tenant-wide scope.

Person.description: One membership in this company. Administrative fields only; this is not a directory of everything known about a person.

RecoveryAcceptedResponse.description: Identical for a known and an unknown address, and identical when rate limited. Any variation here would be an account-existence oracle.

message.example: If that address has an account, a recovery message has been sent.

token.description: Delivered out of band. Never returned by any endpoint.

id.description: null only for a tenant scope.

Invitation.description: An invitation. The token is NEVER included: it is a credential, delivered out of band, and holding one is how a person becomes a member.

scopes.description: Teams and inboxes the invitee will hold. An inviter may only grant scopes they hold themselves.

AcceptInvitationRequest.description: The password creates the identity when the address has no account, and proves it when it does. Without it, holding the link would be enough to attach an established account to a company.

RoleGrantWrite.description: `none` is deliberately not a value: a denial is the absence of a grant, and a second spelling would give every reader two things to check.

UpdateMembershipRequest.description: Only the fields present are changed. An empty body is rejected: it means the caller believes it changed something.

archived.description: Archiving keeps the team's history and frees its name.

OwnershipTransfer.description: An offer the recipient accepts, not something an Owner can do to somebody. One live offer per company.
